platforms.name: Toolroom Records Official Dynamic Demo Upload Route
platforms.country: United Kingdom / Maidstone global house, tech-house and electronic label
platforms.feeAmount: No demo-submission fee or payment requirement is stated on Toolroom Records' official demo page.
platforms.manualReviewReason: Toolroom Records explicitly requires demos to be uploaded through its official demo page and says every submission is heard, but the statically accessible page does not expose the complete rendered uploader fields, accepted file or private-link formats, rights declarations, login state or runtime verification controls. A human must inspect the live uploader, approve every declaration and consent, select a suitable finished track and stop if authentication, CAPTCHA or any payment boundary appears.
platforms.notes: Verified on 2026-07-11 from Toolroom Records' official demo page and current website. The page carries a 2026 copyright notice, active label navigation and a cookie-consent boundary. Public business emails for Academy, Events, Licensing, Press/PR and Store were verified on the official page but are purpose-specific and were not substituted for the demo uploader. No form was submitted, no file or link was supplied, no cookie choice was made and no anti-bot control was handled.

platforms.name: Black Hole Recordings Official Private-Link Demo Submission Route
platforms.country: Netherlands / Breda global trance, progressive-house and melodic electronic label group
platforms.feeAmount: No demo-submission fee or payment requirement is stated in Black Hole Recordings' official submission guidance.
platforms.manualReviewReason: Black Hole Recordings states that demos may be sent through the official channels on its About page and recommends a private streaming link such as SoundCloud together with a short artist bio and relevant links. The complete rendered destination and any live fields, declarations, privacy settings or verification controls must be inspected manually. A human must confirm track-label fit, ownership, master status, private-link permissions and all live terms before delivery.
platforms.notes: Verified on 2026-07-11 from the official Black Hole Recordings About/FAQ page. The label states that it is open to discovering new talent and focuses on trance, progressive house, melodic techno and related electronic subgenres. Current activity is supported by official 2026 events dated August 29 and October 21. The website has a cookie-consent boundary. No demo channel was completed, no account was used, no link or bio was delivered and no consent control was operated.

platforms.name: KEXP Direct Digital Airplay Submission Email Route
platforms.country: United States / Seattle and San Francisco global-listener independent music radio
platforms.feeAmount: KEXP explicitly states that artists cannot pay for airplay consideration.
platforms.manualReviewReason: KEXP publishes md@kexp.org as its authorized rotation-consideration address and requires streaming plus WAV download links rather than attachments, artist and member details, title and label, pronunciation where relevant, focus tracks, release dates, clean edits, lyrics, credits, bio or one-sheet and relevant Pacific Northwest or Bay Area shows. A human must prepare the compliant package, verify rights and link permissions, ensure no attachment is present and decide whether MarcsMusic is a strong editorial fit.
platforms.notes: Verified on 2026-07-11 from KEXP's official contact page and submission guidelines. The site shows current July 2026 events, sessions, playlists and reviews. KEXP's official page also lists general, donor, technical, licensing and DJ contacts, which were classified separately and not used as replacement submission routes. No email was sent, no link or file was delivered and no SMTP/MX/deliverability probing was performed.

platforms.name: Soundplate Free Spotify and Deezer Playlist Submission Workflow
platforms.country: United Kingdom / London global independent playlist-submission platform
platforms.feeAmount: Soundplate describes its playlist-submission service as free; optional promotion and other products are separate from this route.
platforms.manualReviewReason: Soundplate offers free submissions to independent Spotify and Deezer playlists, but each route must be selected for genre fit and the inspected Garage & Bass workflow requires Spotify or Deezer authorization and automatically follows specified Soundplate accounts and playlists before submission. A human must approve OAuth scopes, automatic follow actions, curator relevance, platform terms, track selection and any live verification or consent controls before proceeding.
platforms.notes: Verified on 2026-07-11 from Soundplate's official platform and a live Garage & Bass playlist page. The site lists active electronic, house, drum-and-bass, reggae/dancehall, downtempo and related categories and current 2026 content. One separate playlist endpoint displayed a request-verification interstitial; it was not bypassed or used. No Spotify or Deezer account was connected, no authorization or automatic follow was accepted, no song was submitted and no paid promotion was started.

platforms.name: CKCU 93.1 FM Program Director Pre-Submission Routing Inquiry
platforms.country: Canada / Ottawa community radio with eclectic, electronic, reggae and global programming
platforms.feeAmount: No fee or payment requirement is stated for contacting CKCU's Program Director.
platforms.manualReviewReason: CKCU publicly lists programs@ckcufm.com for its Program Director but does not publish a complete current policy for unsolicited international music, audio formats, download links or metadata. This queue item is restricted to a short asset-free inquiry asking for the authorized music-submission route and requirements. A human must send no audio, attachments or track links until CKCU explicitly confirms the correct destination and rules.
platforms.notes: Verified on 2026-07-11 from CKCU's official contact page and active station homepage. The site publishes current July 2026 programming and events, including indie, electronic, reggae and globally focused content. Official manager, production, program, community and sponsorship business addresses were source-verified; only the Program Director address is retained for an asset-free routing inquiry. No email was sent, no music asset was supplied, no cookie preference was changed and no deliverability probe was performed.
